children: Boston Scientific has restored its manufacturing, order fulfillment and shipping operations after a disruption by last month's cyberattack.

The company late Wednesday said products are moving through its distribution network at or above normal levels as the Marlborough, Mass., company works to fulfill customer orders, reduce backlogs and accelerate the delivery of products.

Boston Scientific earlier this week said it likely won't meet its financial guidance for the third quarter and full year due to the hack, which affected its ability to manufacture, and its ability to process and ship customer orders.

The company said independent assessments from CrowdStrike and other cybersecurity experts since the August 25 breach haven't found any evidence of ongoing threat activity or evidence of compromise to its systems or product technologies.
